title: Undeniable Proof
equation: Persuasion Strength = Result Evidence × Specificity × Relevance
hook: You can explain your value for ten minutes, or show one before and after.
statement: The strongest persuasion closes the imagination gap by showing results people can't ignore.
explainer: The imagination gap is the distance between your promise and someone's ability to picture it working. Explaining barely moves it. Specific, relevant proof closes it fast.
sop: Name the claim you want people to believe.
Gather the evidence that proves it.
Use that proof everywhere, in sales, content, and leadership.
equation_example: Result Evidence 8, Specificity 9, Relevance 6. 8 × 9 × 6 = 432 Persuasion Strength, out of 1,000. Higher means people believe you faster because the proof hits their exact worry. Lower means it's real but too vague to close the gap.
question: Write down one piece of proof that would make your value obvious without any explaining.
closing_statement: Show the result instead of explaining it.
caption:
Principle Nº 269: Undeniable Proof

You can explain your value for ten minutes, or show one before and after.

The strongest persuasion closes the imagination gap by showing results people can't ignore.

Your turn: Write down one piece of proof that would make your value obvious without any explaining.
